mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, username, display_name, status, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND username=#{username} AND deleted=0

SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status}) AND (#{username} IS NULL OR username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{username},'%')) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status}) AND (#{username} IS NULL OR username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{username},'%'))

SELECT ur.role_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_scope='TENANT' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(r.id) FROM sys_role r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_scope='TENANT' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.deleted=0 AND r.id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET display_name=#{displayName},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND version=#{version}
UPDATE sys_user SET status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND version=#{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_role WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (tenant_id,user_id,role_id) SELECT #{tenantId},#{userId},r.id FROM sys_role r WHERE r.id=#{roleId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_scope='TENANT' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.deleted=0
